name: Koko wa Yoru no Doko ka
source:
Hitsugaya has betrayed both the Soul Society and Aizome.
Hueco Mun*o, bored with everyday, starts taking offense at Ichimaru's behavior.

Vague memories of something forgotten.
And when he does remember all of it, Hitsugaya choice is...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034623.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
日番谷背叛了尸魂界和蓝染。

对日常生活感到厌倦的虚圈，对市丸的行为逐渐产生了不满。

那些模糊的记忆，以及被遗忘的一切。

当日番谷终于想起全部真相时，他会做出怎样的选择……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034623.html]DLsite English[/url]]
